tools.note: Repository development utilities; not installed as simulator runtime modules.

tests/harness.note: Process-isolated service acceptance, coverage, mutation, GPU-lease, and subprocess supervision utilities.

error_coupling_simulator.note: Installed simulator distribution. It consumes caller-declared circuits and specified noise processes and emits canonical detector/observable records or explicitly bounded carrier evidence.

error_coupling_simulator/source.note: Replayable finite-RTN, finite-band 1/f, phase-burst, and temporal-storm source processes plus declared source-to-parameter maps.

error_coupling_simulator/mechanisms.note: Explicit Axis-1 generator lowering, Wood-Gambetta qutrit leakage channels/processes, and two-transmon CZ leakage channel derivation.

error_coupling_simulator/quantum_bath.note: Pseudomode-enlarged shared-bath GKSL research carriers, formal controls, record diagnostics, and quantum-memory witnesses.

error_coupling_simulator/frontend.note: Circuit and code compilation, sealed schedules, Stim record generation, Axis-1 execution/evidence, record I/O, optional decoding, and isolated workload adapters.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier.note: Joint-Lindbladian, exact density-matrix, MCWF, tensor-network, canonical record, and within-cycle propagation owners.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier/exact.note: Exact small-register qubit, qutrit, and ququart density-matrix carriers and sequential measurement reference calculations.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier/kernels.note: Optional fused CUDA and C++ kernels with package-owned loaders and reference-path contracts.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier/pepo.note: Retained two-dimensional qutrit density-matrix PEPO carrier. Executable d3 reference checks remain; production record faithfulness and d5/d7 scientific claims remain open.

error_coupling_simulator/carrier/peps.note: Current single-wire two-dimensional qutrit PEPS feasibility carrier. The d3 state/record test surface remains executable; finite-truncation full-record faithfulness and d5/d7 scientific claims remain open.

error_coupling_simulator/certify.note: Protocol-based certification facade, capability/feasibility checks, channel diagnostics, independent reference anchors, and corruption controls.

error_coupling_simulator/certify/anchors.note: Independent density-matrix, Stim-Clifford, closed-form, and corruption-control reference implementations.

error_coupling_simulator/noise_processes.note: Specified record-generating processes with evaluator-only truth, a matched-marginal permutation control, and a source-off control.
